title: Hypothesis failure for Ioana's Theorem 8.2 under a twisted comultiplication (v0.1.3-report)
description: Version v0.1.3-report, manuscript dated 28 October 2026; prepublication gate record. Corrects the summary of Ioana Theorem 8.2 and responds to Section 21 of the 49-page Nielsen NIEWTC artifact and its retained Section 9 appeal. The bounded result remains failure of hypothesis (2) for the specified twisted comultiplication. No nonexistence of morphisms or impossibility of all other routes is asserted. The Lean companion imports the concrete image situation classically and proves the semantic containment-to-intertwining consequence; no full operator-algebra formalization is claimed. Four independent role PASSes at science 9aba11a, accepted fresh targeted Lean/kernel evidence, targeted public-verification-prose PASS at 896c1c9, and root metadata/hash/scope PASS for that successor are recorded in the repository verification record. Final status-only carryforward requires root inspection and exact commit/body authorization before delivery; the release target is v0.1.3-report. Fresh target acceptance does not expand analytic coverage. ArXiv submission and outreach require separate human approval. New version DOI: pending. Historical science v0.1.2 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21859653; science concept DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21845586. Companion Lean v0.1.1-obstruction DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.21859309.
